'''2020 TMW Final Four Matthew Harrison-Trainor LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Final Four).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Final Four
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Yavin 4 Massassi Throne Roo Harris.txt |Download]]
